description: Ex-Philippine Air Force Fokker F27-200 that served as the presidential aircraft of Ferdinand E. Marcos; turned over by the PAF and placed on static display in January 2024 as a tourist attraction. Coordinates are the Silay city centroid, not the airframe. Manila Bulletin's headline said the aircraft went to Negros Oriental; the Philippine News Agency and Wikipedia both place it at Silay City, Negros Occidental.
